# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-01T17:51Z · next run ~23:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-02T07:51Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com
World State 42/100 (Strained) · 18 Alert · 36 Watch · 35 Normal Headline: Iran attacks ships at Hormuz as Doha talks stall and Trump hints at strikes after the 3 Nov midterms. Russia launched 433 drones at Ukraine on 1 Nov, and Cyclone Murasu, on a GDACS red alert, nears India's east coast.
## Situations (8 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, worsening]: Hormuz largely closed: tankers hit on 30–31 Oct, Brent above $110, TTF above €100 and Gulf urea stranded; Doha talks without a deal. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, oil, eu-gas, fertiliser, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, worsening]: 433 Russian drones launched on 1 Nov, leaving hundreds of thousands without power; drones shut Jersey airport on 30–31 Oct. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, hybrid-threats, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.2: drought in Australia and East Africa, record warmth and weaker carbon sinks. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: 10,351 cases and 5,026 deaths reported on 1 Nov, with cases in Kenya and Nigeria; a WHO emergency (PHEIC) since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Record drone attacks on civilians in October; the army rejects talks; famine confirmed in 2025. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - Cyclone Murasu [ALERT, worsening]: GDACS red alert; 383km east of Chennai on 1 Nov, heading for India's east coast. → alert: other-cyclones - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread near 160bp; mass social protests for a third weekend, spreading to Germany. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US CPI at 4.0% on the oil shock; a Bank of England rise to 4% widely expected on 5 Nov; Egypt hiked on 29 Oct. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility; normal: em-stress
## Other Alerts - Global food prices [food-prices] worsening: FAO food index at 136, up 5.8% on a year - Sahel insurgency [sahel] stable: JNIM fuel blockade on Bamako persists; insurgency pressing toward Guinea - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable: UK terrorism threat level raised to Severe: an attack is highly likely
## Changed in last 24h - UK weather warnings [uk-weather]: WATCH→NORMAL — No Met Office weather warnings in force (2026-11-01T11:52Z) - Atmospheric CO₂ [co2]: NORMAL→WATCH — CO₂ growth reaches 2 ppm a year as El Niño weakens carbon sinks (2026-11-01T11:52Z) - Pacific & Indian cyclones [other-cyclones]: NORMAL→ALERT — GDACS red alert as Cyclone Murasu heads for Andhra Pradesh landfall on 3 Nov (2026-11-01T11:52Z) - UK weather warnings [uk-weather]: NORMAL→WATCH — Yellow fog warnings across most of England and Wales for 1 Nov (2026-10-31T23:53Z)
